mapper.select: SELECT * FROM assignments WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignments WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT DISTINCT a.* FROM assignments a INNER JOIN assignment_targets at ON a.assignment_id = at.assignment_id WHERE at.student_id = #{studentId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM assignments WHERE school_id = #{schoolId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assignments (teacher_id, school_id, title, description, target_type, target_level, due_date, is_auto_assign, notify_email, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{teacherId}, #{schoolId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{targetType}, #{targetLevel}, #{dueDate}, #{isAutoAssign}, #{notifyEmail}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE assignments SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, target_type = #{targetType}, target_level = #{targetLevel}, due_date = #{dueDate}, is_auto_assign = #{isAutoAssign}, notify_email = #{notifyEmail}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assignment_problems (assignment_id, problem_id, order_no) VALUES (#{assignmentId}, #{problemId}, #{orderNo})
mapper.select: SELECT a.assignment_id AS assignmentId, a.title, a.description, a.target_level AS targetLevel, a.due_date AS dueDate, a.created_at AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment_problems ap WHERE ap.assignment_id = a.assignment_id) AS problemCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment_targets at WHERE at.assignment_id = a.assignment_id) AS targetCount, (SELECT COALESCE(sc.code_name,'') FROM assignment_problems ap2 JOIN problems p ON ap2.problem_id = p.problem_id LEFT JOIN system_codes sc ON p.subject_code_id = sc.code_id WHERE ap2.assignment_id = a.assignment_id LIMIT 1) AS subject FROM assignments a WHERE a.assignment_id = #{assignmentId}

SELECT at.student_id AS studentId, u.name AS studentName, s.grade, CASE WHEN ls.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS completed, CASE WHEN ls.solved_count > 0 THEN ROUND(ls.correct_count * 100.0 / ls.solved_count) END AS accuracy, ls.completed_at AS completedAt FROM assignment_targets at JOIN students s ON at.student_id = s.student_id JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN learning_sessions ls ON ls.assignment_id = at.assignment_id AND ls.student_id = at.student_id AND ls.session_id = ( SELECT MAX(ls2.session_id) FROM learning_sessions ls2 WHERE ls2.assignment_id = at.assignment_id AND ls2.student_id = at.student_id ) WHERE at.assignment_id = #{assignmentId} ORDER BY u.name

SELECT a.assignment_id AS assignmentId, a.title, a.due_date AS dueDate, a.created_at AS createdAt, (SELECT sc.code_name FROM assignment_problems ap JOIN problems p ON ap.problem_id = p.problem_id LEFT JOIN system_codes sc ON p.subject_code_id = sc.code_id WHERE ap.assignment_id = a.assignment_id LIMIT 1) AS subject, COUNT(DISTINCT at2.student_id) AS targetCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ls.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN ls.student_id END) AS completedCount FROM assignments a LEFT JOIN assignment_targets at2 ON at2.assignment_id = a.assignment_id LEFT JOIN learning_sessions ls ON ls.assignment_id = at2.assignment_id AND ls.student_id = at2.student_id WHERE a.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY a.assignment_id ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE assignments SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, due_date = #{dueDate}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId}
UPDATE assignments SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_sessions WHERE assignment_id = #{assignmentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assignment_targets (assignment_id, class_id, student_id) VALUES (#{assignmentId}, #{classId}, #{studentId})
